papers.title: Artificial Intelligence for Diagnostics and Repair of Household Appliances: Enhancing Efficiency and Cost-Effectiveness
papers.venue: Journal of Research in Science and Engineering
papers.abstract: The article describes the assessment of the impact of artificial intelligence on the efficiency of diagnostics and repair of household appliances. The relevance of the topic lies in the growing complexity of modern equipment, which nowadays includes many different sensors, microprocessors and control systems. The novelty of the study lies in the study and correlation with predictive maintenance of such key performance indicators as the accuracy of fault detection, reduction in repair time and optimization of maintenance costs. The study analyzed data from sensors, error codes and historical usage logs. A comparison of traditional diagnostics and diagnostics using AI was also conducted. The purpose of the study is to demonstrate how to reduce operating costs and improve service quality by applying automation and machine learning methods. The study used a comparative method, statistical data processing and case study analysis. The results confirm the potential of AI in predictive maintenance and its optimization. The conclusions describe the economic benefits of AI integration and its implementation prospects in the field of household appliance repair. The article will be useful for service companies, engineers and researchers studying AI - based solutions in technical diagnostics and maintenance.
papers.summary_zh: 【劳动经济学】本文探讨了人工智能对家用电器诊断与维修效率影响的评估。这一主题的紧迫性在于现代设备的复杂性日益增加，这些设备通常配备有多种传感器、微处理器和控制系统。本研究的新颖之处在于它将人工智能与预测性维护相结合，重点关注故障检测的准确性、维修时间的缩短以及维护成本的优化等关键性能指标。研究分析了来自传感器的数据、错误代码以及设备的历史使用记录，并对传统诊断方法与基于人工智能的诊断方法进行了对比。研究的目的是通过应用自动化和机器学习技术来降低运营成本并提升服务质量。研究采用了比较分析法、统计数据处理以及案例研究等方法。研究结果证实了人工智能在预测性维护及优化方面的潜力。结论部分阐述了人工智能整合所带来的经济效益及其在家用电器维修领域的应用前景。本文对于从事技术诊断与维护领域的研究人员、工程师以及服务企业而言具有较高的参考价值。。研究方法：机器学习、优化方法。

papers.title: Input-Output Price Parity and Farm Profitability: A Strategic Perspective for Karnataka
papers.abstract: Agricultural pricing policies are crucial for farm profitability and food security in India. This study analysed how input and output prices significantly influence the profitability of cereals in Karnataka, with the strategic support prices playing a crucial role in maintaining the price parity. The average annual TFP growth was 1.041 per cent. Rising input costs, particularly for human labour, led to reduced profitability for Jowar (6.12 per cent) and Ragi (4.89 per cent). The net effect was adverse for Jowar (-1.50 per cent) and Ragi (-0.86 per cent) due to rising input costs outpacing output prices. The study recommended increasing the MSP for Jowar (60 per cent) and Ragi (46.24 per cent) above the existing levels. A strategic price adjusted for changing input costs can stabilise farm incomes and promote sustainable production, enabling efficient pricing policies.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】。论文标题：Input-Output Price Parity and Farm Profitability: A Strategic Perspective for Karnataka。摘要概述：该研究围绕「Economics、Finance」相关议题展开，属于金融经济学方向的研究。。结论要点：已基于原文英文摘要提炼主题信息，建议结合原文获取精确结论与量化结果。。

papers.title: Concentration And Distribution of Container Flows In Mauritania's Maritime System (2019-2022)
authors: Moulaye Abdel Kader Ould Moulaye Ismail
papers.abstract: Small, trade-dependent economies often exhibit limited maritime connectivity, yet empirical evidence on the structural configuration of their container systems remains limited. This study analyzes route concentration and node distributions in Mauritania's maritime container system during 2019-2022 using shipment-level data measured in forty-foot equivalent units (FFE). Routes, origin nodes, destination nodes, and industries are represented as FFE-weighted probability distributions, and concentration and divergence metrics are used to assess structural properties. The results show strong corridor concentration across the seven observed routes (HHI = 0.296), with the top three accounting for approximately 84% of total FFE. Node structures differ by direction: imports are associated with a highly concentrated set of destination nodes (HHI = 0.848), while exports originate from only two origin nodes (HHI = 0.567) and are distributed across a large number of destinations (HHI = 0.053). Industry distributions are more concentrated for exports (HHI = 0.352) than for imports (HHI = 0.096), with frozen fish and seafood accounting for more than 53% of export volume. Temporal analysis shows that route concentration remains stable over time (HHI ~ 0.293-0.303), while node distributions exhibit measurable variation, particularly for export destinations (JSD ~ 0.395) and import origins (JSD ~ 0.250).
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】。论文标题：Concentration And Distribution of Container Flows In Mauritania's Maritime System (2019-2022)。摘要概述：该研究围绕「Economics、Finance」相关议题展开，属于金融经济学方向的研究。。结论要点：已基于原文英文摘要提炼主题信息，建议结合原文获取精确结论与量化结果。。

papers.title: Private Healthcare Interventions, Maternal and Infant Mortality Nexus: A Toda-Yamamoto Approach
papers.venue: Journal of economics, finance and management studies
papers.abstract: This study investigates the effect of private healthcare interventions on maternal and infant mortality in Nigeria for the period 1990 to 2024. Private healthcare expenditure as aggregated is the independent variable while maternal mortality ratio and infant mortality ratio are the two dependent variables. Data are analyzed using the Toda-Yamamoto causality approach. The analysis reveals that private healthcare interventions have no statistically significant causal relationship with maternal mortality but it has statistically significant causal relationship with infant mortality in Nigeria. The conclusion emanating from the study is that while domestic interventions, particularly those led by the private sector have contributed meaningfully to reducing infant mortality, they have not yet had significant effects on maternal mortality in Nigeria. It is recommended that the Nigerian government should improve in their partnership with the private sector to increase investment in maternal healthcare services, and that the prevailing interventions by the private sector stakeholders towards reducing infant mortality in Nigeria should be sustained through effective monitoring and evaluation system.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】本研究探讨了1990至2024年间私人医疗干预措施对尼日利亚孕产妇和婴儿死亡率的影响。研究以私人医疗总支出作为自变量，孕产妇死亡率和婴儿死亡率作为因变量。数据分析采用了Toda-Yamamoto因果关系分析方法。结果表明，私人医疗干预措施与孕产妇死亡率之间不存在统计学上的显著因果关系，但与婴儿死亡率之间存在显著因果关系。研究结论指出：尽管国内医疗干预措施（尤其是私营部门主导的干预措施）在降低婴儿死亡率方面发挥了重要作用，但尚未对孕产妇死亡率产生显著影响。建议尼日利亚政府加强与私营部门的合作，增加对孕产妇医疗服务的投入，并通过有效的监测和评估体系持续支持私营部门为降低婴儿死亡率所做的努力。。

papers.title: The impact of oil market volatility on the airline-tourism: quantile VAR approach
papers.summary_zh: 本文属于「风险管理与衍生品」领域，主题为：The impact of oil market volatility on the airline-tourism: quantile VAR approach。涉及关键词：Economics、Business。原文未提供摘要，建议通过 DOI 链接查看全文以了解具体研究方法与结论。

papers.title: Medicaid Coverage for Obesity Medications: Utilization and Net-of-Rebate Spending -- by Coady Wing, Wei-Lun Lo, Maddie Potter, Tarik Yuce, Alberto Ortega, John Cawley, Thuy D. Nguyen, Kosali I. Simon
papers.abstract: We document state variation in Medicaid coverage for obesity-indicated GLP-1 medications over time, and use a stacked difference-in-differences design to estimate the effects of coverage on utilization and net-of-rebate spending. Nine quarters out, coverage increases prescriptions for obesity-indicated GLP-1 medications by 0.82 per 100 enrollee-months (SE = 0.10). Coverage had no effect on GLP-1 prescribing for diabetes or cardiovascular indications, suggesting that off-label prescribing of diabetes formulations for obesity is not very common in the Medicaid program. The expansions do not appear to affect consumer spending at major online GLP-1 compounding firms, which suggests that the utilization response in our main analysis reflects new utilization rather than crowd-out. We find that coverage increases net-of-rebate Medicaid spending by $751.6 per 100 enrollee-months (SE = $92.0), compared to $986.9 in gross reimbursements—manufacturer rebates reduce the state’s net spending by approximately 24 percent. Across the 17 states that ever covered obesity-indicated GLP-1 medications by mid 2025, coverage increased Medicaid net spending by around $2.68 billion per year. Extending Medicaid coverage in the remaining states would generate a further $3.63 billion in annual net spending.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】。论文标题：Medicaid Coverage for Obesity Medications: Utilization and Net-of-Rebate Spending -- by Coady Wing, Wei-Lun Lo, Maddie Potter, Tarik Yuce, Alberto Ortega, John Cawley, Thuy D. Nguyen, Kosali I. Simon。摘要概述：该研究围绕「Economics、Finance」相关议题展开，属于金融经济学方向的研究。。结论要点：已基于原文英文摘要提炼主题信息，建议结合原文获取精确结论与量化结果。。研究方法：双重差分。

papers.title: Reserve Demand Estimation with Minimal Theory -- by Ricardo Lagos, Gastón Navarro
papers.abstract: We propose a new reserve-demand estimation strategy---a middle ground between atheoretical reduced-form econometric approaches and fully structural quantitative-theoretic approaches. The strategy consists of an econometric specification that satisfies core restrictions implied by theory and controls for changes in administered-rate spreads that induce rotations and shifts in reserve demand. The resulting approach is as user-friendly as existing reduced-form econometric methods but improves upon them by incorporating a minimal set of theoretical restrictions that any reserve demand must satisfy. We apply this approach to U.S. data and obtain reserve-demand estimates that are broadly consistent with the structural estimates.
papers.summary_zh: 【风险管理与衍生品】我们提出了一种新的储备需求估算策略——这种策略介于无理论的简化形式计量经济学方法与完全结构化的定量理论方法之间。该策略采用了一种计量经济学模型，该模型满足了理论所隐含的核心约束条件，并考虑了管理利率利差的变化对储备需求产生的影响（这些变化会导致储备需求的变动）。这种新方法与现有的简化形式计量经济学方法一样易于使用，但通过纳入任何储备需求都必须满足的最基本理论约束条件而对其进行了改进。我们将这一方法应用于美国的数据，得到的储备需求估算结果与基于结构模型的估算结果大体一致。。

papers.title: The Econometrics of Utility Transferability in Dyadic Network Formation Models
papers.abstract: This paper studies how to estimate an individual's taste for forming a connection with another individual in a network. It compares the difficulty of estimation with and without the assumption that utility is transferable between individuals, and with and without the assumption that regressors are symmetric across individuals in the pair. I show that when pair-specific regressors are symmetric, the sufficient conditions for consistency and asymptotic normality of the maximum likelihood estimator that assumes transferable utility (TU-MLE) are also sufficient for the maximum likelihood estimator that does not assume transferable utility (NTU-MLE). When regressors are asymmetric, I provide sufficient conditions for the consistency and asymptotic normality of the NTU-MLE. I also provide a specification test to assess the validity of the transferable utility assumption. Two applications from different fields of economics demonstrate the value of my results. I find evidence of researchers using the TU-MLE when the transferable utility assumption is violated, and evidence of researchers using NTU-model-based estimators when the validity of the transferable utility assumption cannot be rejected.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】本文探讨了如何估计个体在网络中与他人建立联系的偏好。研究比较了在假设效用可以在个体之间传递与不假设效用可传递的情况下，以及在假设成对个体中的回归量具有对称性与不假设回归量对称性的情况下，进行此类估计的难度。研究发现，当成对个体中的回归量具有对称性时，假设效用可传递（TU-MLE）的最大似然估计量的一致性和渐近正态性的充分条件，同样适用于不假设效用可传递（NTU-MLE）的最大似然估计量。当回归量不对称时，本文为NTU-MLE的一致性和渐近正态性提供了充分条件，并提出了一种规范检验方法来评估效用可传递假设的有效性。来自经济学不同领域的两个应用实例展示了本文研究结果的实际价值：研究发现，在效用可传递假设不成立的情况下，研究人员仍使用TU-MLE；而在无法拒绝效用可传递假设的有效性时，研究人员则采用基于NTU模型的估计方法。。

papers.title: Sensitivity Analysis for Instrumental Variables Under Joint Relaxations of Monotonicity and Independence
papers.abstract: In this paper I develop a breakdown frontier approach to assess the sensitivity of Local Average Treatment Effects (LATE) estimates to violations of monotonicity and independence of the instrument. I parametrize violations of independence using the concept of $c$-dependence from Masten & Poirier (2018) and allow for the share of defiers to be greater than zero but smaller than the share of compliers. I derive identified sets for the LATE and the Average Treatment Effect (ATE) in which the bounds are functions of these two sensitivity parameters. Using these bounds, I derive the breakdown frontier for the LATE, which is the weakest set of assumptions such that a conclusion regarding the LATE holds. I derive consistent sample analogue estimators for the breakdown frontiers and provide a valid bootstrap procedure for inference. Monte Carlo simulations show the desirable finite-sample properties of the estimators and an empirical application shows that the conclusions regarding the effect of family size on unemployment from Angrist & Evans (1998) are highly sensitive to violations of independence and monotonicity.
papers.summary_zh: 【风险管理与衍生品】在本文中，我提出了一种分解边界（breakdown frontier）方法，用于评估局部平均处理效应（Local Average Treatment Effects, LATE）估计对工具变量（instrument）单调性和独立性违规的敏感性。我借鉴Masten和Poirier（2018）提出的$c$-依赖性概念来量化独立性的违规情况，并允许违规者的比例大于遵守者的比例，但同时限制这一比例不能超过某个上限。我推导出了LATE和平均处理效应（Average Treatment Effect, ATE）的识别集，这些识别集的界限是这两个敏感性参数的函数。基于这些界限，我确定了LATE成立所需的最弱假设集合，即所谓的“分解边界”。我还为这些分解边界推导出了基于样本的估计量，并提供了一种有效的自助法（bootstrap procedure）来进行推断。蒙特卡洛模拟验证了这些估计量的良好有限样本性质；实证应用表明，Angrist和Evans（1998）关于家庭规模对失业率影响的结论对独立性和单调性违规非常敏感。。研究方法：蒙特卡洛模拟、数值模拟。

papers.title: Conformal Prediction for Nonparametric Instrumental Regression
papers.abstract: We propose a method for constructing distribution-free prediction intervals in nonparametric instrumental variable regression (NPIV), with finite-sample coverage guarantees. Building on the conditional guarantee framework in conformal inference, we reformulate conditional coverage as marginal coverage over a class of IV shifts $\mathcal{F}$. Our method can be combined with any NPIV estimator, including sieve 2SLS and other machine-learning-based NPIV methods such as neural networks minimax approaches. Our theoretical analysis establishes distribution-free, finite-sample coverage over a practitioner-chosen class of IV shifts.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】我们提出了一种用于在非参数工具变量回归（NPIV）中构建无分布预测区间的方法，并确保了该方法的有限样本覆盖性质。该方法基于共形推断中的条件覆盖框架，将条件覆盖重新定义为对一类工具变量（IV）变动$\mathcal{F}$的边际覆盖。我们的方法可以与任何NPIV估计量结合使用，包括筛选2SLS（sieve 2SLS）以及其他基于机器学习的NPIV方法，如神经网络极小极大（neural network minimax）算法。我们的理论分析证明了该方法在实践者选定的工具变量变动类别上具有无分布性质和有限样本覆盖能力。。研究方法：回归分析、工具变量、神经网络。

papers.title: Marital Sorting on Pre-Marital Preferences for Household Behavior
papers.abstract: We study marital sorting using a novel dataset from a marriage matching platform, which uniquely records a rich set of pre-marital attributes, including preferences for children and for the division of housework and childcare. Unlike census or post-marital surveys, all characteristics are collected prior to matching and validated using official documents, yielding clean measures of preferences uncontaminated by post-marital coordination. Applying a multidimensional matching framework to twelve attributes, we find strong positive assortative matching across all dimensions. Age is the most salient trait, but preferences for children are the second most important - exceeding education - a pattern largely invisible in standard data. Preference measures play a distinct role in the matching process: they exhibit limited cross-attribute interactions with sociodemographic and anthropometric characteristics, in contrast to the pervasive interactions among those attributes. A low-dimensional factor representation shows that preferences for children constitute a separate and salient margin of sorting. Using the staged structure of the platform, we further show that assortative matching along different dimensions emerges at distinct points in the dating process: sorting by age and income is already present at the initial Application stage, whereas sorting by preferences for children becomes robust only at later stages of relationship formation, reflecting selective continuation rather than sorting at the point of final agreement. A simple theoretical exercise demonstrates that ignoring preference-based sorting and assuming homogeneous preferences across couples leads to biased estimates of policy effects on subsequent household decisions.
papers.summary_zh: 【劳动经济学】我们利用一个来自婚姻匹配平台的新数据集来研究婚姻匹配现象。该数据集独特地记录了丰富的婚前信息，包括对子女的偏好以及对于家务和育儿分工的意愿。与人口普查或婚后调查不同，所有这些特征都是在匹配之前收集的，并通过官方文件进行了验证，因此能够获得不受婚后协调影响、较为准确的偏好数据。通过将多维匹配模型应用于这十二个特征，我们发现所有维度上都存在显著的正向同配现象（即相似特征的人更倾向于配对）。年龄是最显著的匹配因素，但对子女的偏好位居第二位，其重要性超过了教育水平——这种模式在标准数据中往往难以观察到。偏好数据在匹配过程中起着独特的作用：与其他社会人口统计特征和人体测量特征相比，偏好数据与其他特征之间的交互作用较为有限。低维因子分析表明，对子女的偏好构成了一个独立且重要的匹配维度。通过分析该平台的匹配流程，我们进一步发现：不同维度的同配现象在约会过程中的不同阶段逐渐显现：基于年龄和收入的匹配在初始申请阶段就已经存在，而基于子女偏好的匹配则主要在关系形成的后期才变得明显，这反映了人们在达成最终协议后的选择性延续行为，而非在协议达成时就已经完成了匹配过程。一个简单的理论分析表明，如果忽略基于...。研究方法：调查数据。

papers.title: Optimal Dividend, Reinsurance, and Capital Injection for Collaborating Business Lines under Model Uncertainty
papers.abstract: This paper considers an insurer with two collaborating business lines that faces three critical decisions: (1) dividend payout, (2) reinsurance coverage, and (3) capital injection between the lines, in the presence of model uncertainty. The insurer considers the reference model to be an approximation of the true model, and each line has its own robustness preference. The reserve level of each line is modeled using a diffusion process. The objective is to obtain a robust strategy that maximizes the expected weighted sum of discounted dividends until the first ruin time, while incorporating a penalty term for the distortion between the reference and alternative models in the worst-case scenario. We completely solve this problem and obtain the value function and optimal (equilibrium) strategies in closed form. We show that the optimal dividend-capital injection strategy is a barrier strategy. The optimal proportion of risk ceded to the reinsurer and the deviation of the worst-case model from the reference model are decreasing with respect to the aggregate reserve level. Finally, numerical examples are presented to show the impact of the model parameters and ambiguity aversion on the optimal strategies.
papers.summary_zh: 【劳动经济学】本文研究了一家拥有两个相互协作业务部门的保险公司，在模型不确定性存在的情况下，该公司需要面对三个关键决策：（1）股息支付；（2）再保险覆盖范围；（3）部门之间的资本注入。保险公司认为参考模型是对真实模型的近似，且每个业务部门都有其自身的鲁棒性偏好。每个部门的准备金水平通过扩散过程进行建模。研究目标是在考虑最坏情况下参考模型与替代模型之间差异所带来的惩罚因素的同时，制定一种能够最大化首次破产前预期折现股息加权总和的鲁棒策略。我们成功解决了这一问题，并以封闭形式得到了价值函数及最优（均衡）策略。研究表明，最优的股息-资本注入策略属于一种“屏障策略”（即通过调整资本注入来降低风险）。向再保险公司转移的风险比例以及最坏情况模型与参考模型的偏差都会随着总准备金水平的提高而减小。最后，通过数值示例展示了模型参数及对不确定性厌恶程度的不同偏好对最优策略的影响。。研究方法：均衡模型。
